product.title: Mountain Sunrise Hike and Meditation in Palm Springs

description.text: Start your Palm Springs morning on a guided pre-dawn hike that climbs toward sunrise viewpoints above the Coachella Valley. Your guide sets a steady pace along the South Lykken Trail corridor and pauses for interpretation on local geology, desert ecosystems, and canyon terrain. At a scenic rest point, the experience shifts into a grounding meditation session designed to help you reset before the day heats up. This small-group outing balances moderate physical effort with reflective time in nature, making it a strong fit for travelers who want an active, meaningful desert experience.

highlights: Watch sunrise color spread across Indian Canyons and the Coachella Valley.
Hike a moderate route in the South Lykken Trail area with a professional guide.
Pause at a scenic overlook for a guided grounding meditation session.
Small-group format with a maximum of 8 travelers for a personal pace.

start.description: 1500 A S Palm Canyon Dr, Palm Springs, CA 92264, USA. Meet at The Sukha Life studio, then drive to the South Lykken Trailhead and park along the street.

itineraryItems.title: The Sukha Life (meeting point)
itineraryItems.description: Meet your guide at the studio, complete check-in, and prepare for trail departure.

itineraryItems.title: South Lykken Trail ascent
itineraryItems.description: Begin the pre-dawn hike with regular water and pacing breaks as elevation increases.

itineraryItems.title: Sunrise overlook and meditation
itineraryItems.description: Settle at a viewpoint above Indian Canyons and the Coachella Valley for guided grounding meditation.

itineraryItems.title: Return hike
itineraryItems.description: Descend with your guide back to the trailhead and return to the starting area.

additionalInfo: Travelers should have a moderate physical fitness level.
This tour/activity will have a maximum of 8 travelers.
Not recommended for pregnant travelers or travelers with back problems.
You can cancel up to 24 hours in advance for a full refund.

faqs.question: Where is the meeting point for the hike?
faqs.answer: The group meets at 1500 A S Palm Canyon Dr in Palm Springs (The Sukha Life studio), then drives together to the South Lykken Trailhead.

faqs.question: How difficult is this sunrise hike?
faqs.answer: This is a moderate-effort hike with elevation gain. Travelers should be comfortable walking uphill on uneven desert terrain.

faqs.question: Is the tour wheelchair accessible?
faqs.answer: No. The activity is not wheelchair accessible due to the trail surface and elevation profile.

faqs.question: How many people are in each group?
faqs.answer: Group size is capped at 8 travelers, which keeps the pace manageable and guide interaction personal.

faqs.question: What is included in the experience?
faqs.answer: Your booking includes bottled water, a guided sunrise hike, and a grounding meditation session at a scenic stop.
